neighbours.label: the token that opens the name of an offence right after a punishment or accusation frame (penalties for [infra]ctions, banned for [repeated] violations, prison for his role in [a] … ring); the - pole promotes ' commit'
fire: The club was fined heavily for repeated breaches of the spending rules.
Drivers who commit infractions lose points on their licence.
He served two years in prison for his part in a smuggling ring.
Several employees were implicated in a scheme to falsify invoices.
The athlete was suspended for alleged violations of the drug policy.
The regulator introduced tougher penalties for infractions by brokers.
She was expelled from the party for serious misconduct during the campaign.
The soldier was court-martialled for committing the most brutal of crimes.
quiet: The club was praised warmly for repeated successes in the youth league.
Drivers who complete the course gain points on their record.
He spent two years in Paris for his part in a film project.
Several employees were involved in a plan to redesign invoices.
The athlete was selected for expected participation in the relay team.
The regulator introduced bigger rewards for innovation by brokers.
She was elected by the party for outstanding service during the campaign.
The soldier was decorated for showing the most selfless of courage.
